scope: Outcome-blind feasibility audit after negative v12; not a performance experiment or preregistration
patient_policy: Read retained public subject IDs only, never diagnosis, CRS-R, manual stage labels or previous patient predictions. Retain original45/23/41 identities. Do not remove subjects missing the optional opt2 condition.
binder: Verify opt2 ITPC/envelope identity, exact released trace reconstruction with available original channels, overlap with retained opt5 IDs, and opt5 finite full-frequency response regions. Second stimulus is an optional view, never a basis for restricting the primary cohort. No single-trial or voltage data implied.
wielek: Count boundary-safe lag1/2/4/8 stage pairs using only myPredict, time and time_record; do not bridge any intervening nonconsecutive epoch or record boundary. Report automatic stage-stream availability, not raw-EEG signal availability.
mendeley: Inspect complete frozen per-block six-channel theta/alpha matrices and boundary-safe clean adjacent pairs. Audit contains no new raw preprocessing or QC choices.
reporting: Availability, axis sizes and numerical reconstruction errors only; no label-conditioned feature selection, AUC or performance conclusion. Freeze source/code hashes and preserve all old results/manuscript.
